# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

This project is maintained on a best-effort basis. Latest `main` is supported. Please report vulnerabilities privately.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

- Do not file public issues for security problems.
- Use GitHub's private “Report a vulnerability”/Security Advisory feature for this repository if available.
- If that is not available, open a new issue with the title starting with "[SECURITY]" and request a private contact channel; do not include sensitive details in the public text.

We aim to acknowledge reports within 72 hours.
